page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.2xlarge is an accelerator-oriented instance in the ecs.gn6v family designed for GPU-centric computing tasks. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, delivering 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. System memory totals 32.0 GB, providing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. A core component of this hardware configuration is a dedicated NVIDIA Volta V100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include bundled local storage and operates with a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Empirical benchmark results indicate that host CPU computing capacity falls within lower baseline percentiles relative to modern general-purpose instances. Single-core Geekbench performance registered 604.0 while multi-core achieved 2324.0. PassMark CPU scored 6136.75 and stress-ng multi-core reached 5895.65. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrated uncached large-block write speeds of 35.65 GB/sec and read speeds of 39.02 GB/sec. CPU feature reporting notes the absence of vector acceleration flags such as AVX and AVX-512, emphasizing that high-intensity mathematical operations are intended to be offloaded to the Volta GPU architecture rather than executed on the host CPU.

Resource efficiency on this instance type is shaped by pairing a dedicated enterprise accelerator with an economical host compute footprint. By allocating 8 vCPUs and 32 GB of RAM, the system minimizes host infrastructure overhead while maintaining access to dedicated tensor compute capabilities. With no local disk bundled, the configuration relies on remote storage volumes for dataset persistence. The server is suited for machine learning model training, AI inference, GPU-accelerated scientific simulations, parallel mathematical modeling, and video processing pipelines.

Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz across 4 physical cores, the platform provides dedicated host resources for accelerator-heavy environments. Given its hardware balance, the ecs.gn6v-c8g1.2xlarge is suited for machine learning training, AI model inference, scientific simulations, and GPU-driven rendering pipelines where host processing requirements are secondary to parallel accelerator performance.
